0022600005.text: Both the Los Angeles Lakers and Golden State Warriors open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Lakers hosting. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody, who are both out following knee surgery, and Kristaps Porzingis is day-to-day with an undisclosed reason and is a game-time decision. The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 119-103 win in Golden State on April 9, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Lakers a 65% chance of winning.
